name: Framboos
description:
3 Fonteinen Framboos is the result of macerating hand-picked whole raspberries on young lambic for at least four months, in a proportion of one kilogram of fruit per litre of lambic. The raspberry lambic is then blended again with more young lambic to obtain a minimum intensity of 35% fruit, and is bottled immediately afterwards. These bottles are then stored in our cellars for at least five months so that the raspberry lambic can develop into a beautiful, traditional, and vibrant Framboos. With a abundant forest fruit nose as it warms in the glass, 3 Fonteinen Framboos will age perfectly but may lose some of the vibrant colours and forest fruit aromas.

This unfiltered and unpasteurised lambic is all-natural with no artificial juices, syrups, or sugars added. Traditional Lambic is living, cultural heritage rooted in the Zenne valley!
description_zh: 3泉Framboos：手摘整颗树莓在年轻兰比克上浸渍至少四个月（每升兰比克一公斤果），再混入更多年轻兰比克使果含量至少35%后即装瓶，瓶储至少五个月；不过滤、不杀菌，不添加人工果汁、糖浆或糖。

name: Persistence Is Utile #VIII x LOT61
description:
For our 8th edition of Persistence Is Utile sees us team up with coffeemasters, LOT61 from Amsterdam.

We’ve incorporated 40kg of Yunnan Red Sparrow beans, which underwent a thermal shock process, which sees coffee cherries undergo high heat, then immediate cold cooling. The dramatic temperature shifts create a ‘stress response’ in the bean, resulting in intense, complex and fruity notes.

This is then seamlessly blended with a heavy foundation of chocolate and Munich malt, intensifying the decadent experience of PIU while maintaining a remarkably clean, thick, and smooth mouthfeel. Cacao nibs and vanilla are added to temper any sharpness from the coffee, culminating in a drinking experience defined by luxury and profound richness.
description_zh: Persistence Is Utile第八辑，与阿姆斯特丹咖啡名店LOT61合作：加入40公斤云南红雀咖啡豆，豆子经热冲击处理（咖啡果高温后骤冷激发“应激反应”，果香复杂浓郁），配厚重巧克力与慕尼黑麦芽，可可粒与香草柔化咖啡锋芒，奢华浓醇、干净厚滑。
